name: LifePair Matrimonial Website
description: A platform where user find their perfect match and hearts meet and dreams begin.
details: A fully functional matrimonial website built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. It allows users to create biodata, browse potential matches, and connect with each other. The admin panel provides insights into user activity, premium memberships, and completed marriages.
challenges: Implementing secure authentication and optimizing performance.
improvements: Adding a more search functionality in the biodata routes.
